issues.explanation: removeMember resolves a scoped membership and deletes it with last-manager abort but shows no $this->authorize call, unlike every sibling action, so the delete policy (never the owner) is not enforced server-side.
No routes change is in the diff, so the required route-level 403 for entity.members is missing and must be treated as missing per the review rules.
selectedMembershipId is a public ?int holding server context but lacks #[Locked], violating the Livewire lock rule; tampering is only mitigated by entity-scoped findOrFail.
Livewire inputs use inline $this->validate([...]) with no #[Validate] attributes on inviteEmail, inviteRole or memberRole, deviating from the #[Validate] + validate pattern.
members.blade has no explicit @error('inviteEmail') directive and relies on x-input to render the error, which cannot be verified from the diff despite the single help is-danger test.
Domain writes are done directly in Livewire components instead of app/Actions/* as the conventions require.
The Unreleased changelog entry is duplicated under the released [0.0.0] section, which should not be edited.
cancelRemoval and closeMember mutate UI state with no authorization check; low risk but inconsistent with authorizing every public action.

review.summary: The change implements invite-only membership with expiry, rate limiting, queued mail, pending-invites UI and manager-only members modals, with extensive tests. It needs changes before merging because removeMember shows no server-side authorization, the route-level 403 and #[Locked]/#[Validate] conventions are missed, and the changelog edits a released section.
